name: Meat smoked over the fire
summary: Buffalo or pork belly is seasoned with mắc khén, chili, and ginger and smoked slowly over the kitchen fire until it is dry outside and still soft, sweet, and dark pink inside. Thai households make most of it at the start of the year, for Tết and for guests.
origin: Thai households in Quan Hóa and Bá Thước. Sources: VnExpress, 3 Jul 2023; The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 26 Sep 2026.
texture: Dry outside, soft and sweet inside, and dark pink.
taste: Seasoned with mắc khén, chili, and ginger.
howToEat: At the house table at the start of the year, or bought to carry home.
where: Thai households in Quan Hóa and Bá Thước. Smoked meat is also sold at highland markets, Phố Đoàn among them.
seoTitle: Smoked meat in Pu Luong — buffalo or pork belly
seoDescription: Thịt gác bếp is buffalo or pork belly smoked over the kitchen fire with mắc khén, chili, and ginger.
